newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Rowan Cos estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Rowan Cos estimate raised.

text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc said Monday it raised its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for Rowan Cos Inc to $2.00 a share from $1.75, citing relative commodity price stability and balanced drilling markets.
-- Hanifen also cited two new contracts signed by Rowan Fort Worth that feature higher jackup day rates.

-- However, Hanifen also lowered its estimate for the first quarter to $0.28 from $0.30 in anticipation of a loss of $2.0 million on the Rowan Juneau turnkey rig job with Pennzoil Co in the Gulf of Mexico.
-- Rowan provides offshore contract drilling and aviation services.
-- Its shares were off 1/8 Monday at 22-3/8.
